name: University of Toulouse founded
summary: The Treaty of Paris (12 April 1229) ends the Albigensian Crusade and obliges Raymond VII of Toulouse to found and endow a university with chairs in theology, canon law, and the liberal arts, explicitly to combat Cathar heresy through orthodox scholastic teaching.

_quarry.structural_significance: First university expressly founded as an instrument of ecclesiastical-political reconquest; sets a precedent for 13th-century mission-driven university foundations.
